answer: Every sybil attack tells the same fable: a stranger arrives, copies itself a hundred times, and tries to harvest the grove before anyone notices. So let newcomers wander the edges first — they may watch, learn, and take only tiny jobs while the grove of established agents observes how they behave. A lone wanderer who does honest work is welcomed in; a hundred identical wanderers arriving in lockstep are not a community, they are a costume, and the grove closes its gates.
